26:     for (size_t i = 0; i < value.size(); ++i) {
27:         if (value[i] == '+') {
28:             decoded.push_back(' ');
29:             continue;
30:         }
31: 
32:         if (value[i] == '%' && i + 2 < value.size()) {
33:             int high = hex_value(value[i + 1]);
34:             int low = hex_value(value[i + 2]);
35:             if (high != -1 && low != -1) {
36:                 decoded.push_back(static_cast<char>(high * 16 + low));
37:                 i += 2;
38:                 continue;
39:             }
40:         }
41: 
42:         decoded.push_back(value[i]);
43:     }
44: 
45:     return decoded;
46: }

49: QueryFields parse_query(std::string_view body) {
50:     QueryFields fields;
51: 
52:     size_t start = 0;
53:     while (start < body.size()) {
54:         size_t end = body.find('&', start);
55:         if (end == std::string_view::npos) {
56:             end = body.size();
57:         }
58: 
59:         std::string_view part = body.substr(start, end - start);
60:         size_t eq = part.find('=');
61: 
62:         std::string key = url_decode(part.substr(0, eq));
63:         std::string value;
64:         if (eq != std::string_view::npos) {
65:             value = url_decode(part.substr(eq + 1));
66:         }
67: 
68:         if (!key.empty()) {
69:             fields[std::move(key)] = std::move(value);
70:         }
71: 
72:         start = end + 1;
73:     }
74: 
75:     return fields;
76: }

35:     data += std::to_string(static_cast<int>(status));
36:     data += " ";
37:     data += reason_phrase(status);

39: 
40:     bool has_content_length = false;

48:             has_connection = true;
